spearheads.name: Ironjawz Bigmob
spearheads.text:
Bigmobs are loose but effective formations assembled when a Megaboss decides to leave something battered and brutalised on a whim. They may serve as the start of a burgeoning Waaagh! or form from the remnants of one, or else they may simply be a group of orruks that have wandered into the orbit of a warleader in pursuit of action. All that’s needed for a Bigmob to form is an Ironjaw to decide they fancy a brawl and a handful of ladz to follow their lead.
The Megaboss leading a Bigmob is joined by whichever of their boyz can keep up. Usually, these are Ragerz: swaggering berserkers who have discarded much of their armour to reach the best kills first. Ardboyz often tag along as well. These are sent to lay claim to far-flung points of the battlefield, partially because they fight well on the defence but also because it stops the boss from having to hear their militaristic grumbling. An awful, flesh-mangling din rings out whenever a Bigmob gets stuck in, one that carries far and sees Brute mobs get drawn to the clamour. Infuriated at missing the start of the fun, these orruks are in a hurry to get stuck in. The force of their glowering can see smaller enemies who’d otherwise try and waylay them shrink away in dread.

battle_traits.name: 'ERE WE GO!
battle_traits.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

battle_traits.name: MIGHTY DESTROYERS
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that was not set up this turn to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

regiment_abilities.name: NATURAL DISASTER
regiment_abilities.effect: If you make an unmodified charge roll of 8+ for a friendly unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

regiment_abilities.name: A PROPER RUCKUS
regiment_abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability
regiment_abilities.effect: All friendly units on the battlefield that were not set up this turn are the targets of that ability instead.

enhancements.name: AMBERSTONE WHETSTONE
enhancements.effect: The Rend characteristic of your general’s melee weapons is 2.

enhancements.name: MEGA BOSSY
enhancements.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: GET STUCK IN, LADZ
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: YOU MESSIN'?
abilities.effect: Enemy models with a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: UNLEASHED RAGE
abilities.effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: SHIELD BASH
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a shield bash roll of D6 for each model in this unit that is within 3" of the target. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
